The test image shows corn stalks with:
- Dark brown to shiny black discoloration of the stalk rind
- Large coalescing black blotches/streaks along the stalk surface
- Somewhat shredded/deteriorated stalk tissue
- Characteristic dark water-soaked lesions merging into extensive black areas

The reference images for Anthracnose stalk rot confirm this pattern — particularly the distinctive shiny black discoloration of the stalk rind with dark lesions joining into large blotches, which is the hallmark symptom of this disease.
